problem: When should you use prompting, RAG, SFT or LoRA?
principle: Retrieve changing facts; adapt stable behavior. LoRA freezes W and learns BA. It is an update method, not a separate task objective.
solutions: Base and activations still cost memory
check: Must you choose either SFT or LoRA?
answer: No. SFT is an objective/data setup; LoRA is a parameter-update method. They can be combined.
diagram_title: LoRA: frozen base plus low-rank update
